basic_details.short_information: The Directorate of Shipping Services under the Andaman & Nicobar Administration has invited applications for one post of Deputy Director (Shipping Services), a Group 'A' Gazetted (Non-Ministerial) post in the Pay Matrix (₹ 67700-208700) Pay Level - 11, to be filled on deputation for three (03) years. Eligible officers need a degree of a recognized University and five years of Administrative experience, three of them in operation on Mainland/Inter Island Shipping Services. The application in the Annexure-A format must be sent to The Secretary (Shipping), A&N Administration, Sri Vijaya Puram – 7

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation (ISTC) is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of the receipt of application. The circular does not print any age relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

qualification.details: Degree of a recognized University. Five years Administrative experience, out of which, three years should be in operation on Mainland/Inter Island Shipping Services.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application/Bio-data in the format at Annexure-A (Bio-Data Proforma) printed with the circular.
Sign the application and get it certified by your Head of Office/Employer, who also countersigns it with the seal.
Have the employer complete the "Certificate to be furnished by Employer/Head of Office/Forwarding Authority" printed after the proforma.
Forward the complete application to The Secretary (Shipping), A&N Administration, Sri Vijaya Puram – 744101, through proper channel.
The duly filled-in application may also be emailed to the Deputy Secretary (Shipping) at [email protected].

Send the application within 30 days from the date of publication of the vacancy notice in Employment News. The circular does not print the Employment News publication date. Counted from the date beside the signature (13 November 2026), 30 days would be about 13 December 2026, but the actual deadline runs from the Employment News publication.
Name and address in block letters, office and residential addresses with telephone numbers, fax number, mobile number and email ID.
Date of birth (copy attached) and date of retirement under the rules that apply to you.
Educational and other qualifications and training (self-attested copies attached), compared against the essential and desired requirements of the post.
Details of service in chronological order: office, post held, period (from/to), scale of pay, basic pay and nature of duties.
Nature of present employment, deputation/contract details, type of present employer, revised pay scale, total monthly emoluments, and whether you belong to SC/ST/OBC.
Complete and up-to-date ACRs/APARs for the last 05 years; photocopies must be attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent.
Certificate regarding imposition of major/minor penalties during the last 10 years.
No Objection Certificate from the employer regarding the proposed deputation, and forwarding of the application through proper channel to A&N Administration.

Through the employer's certificate, the forwarding authority confirms the particulars, that no vigilance case is pending or contemplated, that integrity is beyond doubt, and the penalty position for the last 10 years.
important_instructions: Candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw subsequently. Applications of officers against whom disciplinary/vigilance cases are pending or being contemplated need not be forwarded. Incomplete applications, advance copies of applications, applications received after the due date and applications without the listed documents will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About the Directorate of Shipping Services
content_sections.text: The Directorate of Shipping Services works under the Andaman & Nicobar Administration. The circular is issued by the Deputy Secretary (Shipping), and applications go to The Secretary (Shipping), A&N Administration, at Sri Vijaya Puram. The post is in the Group 'A' Gazetted (Non-Ministerial) cadre of the Directorate.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is filled by the Composite Method (Deputation (ISTC) plus Promotion). Only serving officers can apply, through their employer. The circular names two groups of eligible officers. Officers not below the rank of Lieutenant in the Indian Navy having sea or command experience. OR Officers working under the Central/States Govts./U.Ts/Public Sector Undertaking/Statutory Bodies and Autonomous Organization who meet condition (A) and condition (B): (A) Any one of the following: (i) holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre; or (ii) with Five (5) years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in the Pay Matrix (₹ 53100-167800) Pay Level - 09 revised or equivalent in parent cadre/department; or (iii) with Six (6) years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in the Pay Matrix (₹ 47600-151100) Pay Level - 08 revised or equivalent in parent cadre/department; or (iv) with Seven (7) years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in the Pay Matrix (₹ 44900-142400) Pay Level - 07 revised or equivalent in parent cadre/department. (B) Possessing the educational qualification and experience prescribed for direct recruitment under para-7. Degree of a recognized University. Five years Administrative experience, out of which, three years should be in operation on Mainland/Inter Island Shipping Services. For appointment on deputation, service rendered on a regular basis by an officer before 01.01.2016 (the date from which the revised pay structure based on the 7th CPC recommendation has been extended) is deemed to be service rendered in the corresponding level in the Pay Matrix extended on the recommendation of the pay commission. The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation (ISTC) is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of the receipt of application. The circular does not print any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Pay Matrix (₹ 67700-208700) Pay Level - 11. Pay of the selected officer: regulated in terms of the Department of Personnel & Training's orders contained in their OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. Period of deputation: three (03) years. Overall limit: the period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or some other organisation/department of the Central Govt., shall ordinarily not exceed 04 (four) years. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there for Deputy Director (Shipping Services) in A&N Administration?
faq.answer: There is one post of Deputy Director (Shipping Services) in the Directorate of Shipping Services, to be filled on deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the A&N Administration Deputy Director (Shipping Services) post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 30 days from the date of publication of the vacancy notice in Employment News; late applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Deputy Director (Shipping Services)?
faq.answer: A degree of a recognized University and five years of Administrative experience, out of which three years should be in operation on Mainland/Inter Island Shipping Services.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the A&N Administration Deputy Director (Shipping Services) deputation?
faq.answer: The maximum age for appointment on deputation (ISTC) is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of the receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for Deputy Director (Shipping Services)?
faq.answer: The post is in the Pay Matrix (₹ 67700-208700) Pay Level - 11, and the deputationist's pay is regulated under DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Deputy Director (Shipping Services) post?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-A bio-data, signed and certified by your Head of Office/Employer, with the listed documents to The Secretary (Shipping), A&N Administration, Sri Vijaya Puram – 744101; it may also be emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Can Indian Navy officers apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. Officers not below the rank of Lieutenant in the Indian Navy having sea or command experience are eligible.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job, and for how long is the deputation?
faq.answer: No. The post is filled on deputation for three (03) years, and total deputation including any immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed 04 (four) years.

faq.question: Q9. Can I withdraw my application after applying?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw subsequently.
